pub fn clone() callconv(.naked) u32 {
    // __clone(func, stack, flags, arg, ptid, tls, ctid)
    //         a0,   a1,    a2,    a3,  +0,   +4,  +8
    //
    // syscall(SYS_clone, flags, stack, ptid, tls, ctid)
    //         v0         a0,    a1,    a2,   a3,  +0
    asm volatile (
        \\ # Save function pointer and argument pointer on new thread stack
        \\ and $a1, $a1, -8
        \\ subu $a1, $a1, 16
        \\ sw $a0, 0($a1)
        \\ sw $a3, 4($a1)
        \\
        \\ # Shuffle (fn,sp,fl,arg,ptid,tls,ctid) to (fl,sp,ptid,tls,ctid)
        \\ move $a0, $a2
        \\ lw $a2, 16($sp)
        \\ lw $a3, 20($sp)
        \\ lw $t1, 24($sp)
        \\ subu $sp, $sp, 16
        \\ sw $t1, 16($sp)
        \\ li $v0, 4120 # SYS_clone
        \\ syscall
        \\ beq $a3, $zero, 1f
        \\ blez $v0, 2f
        \\ subu $v0, $zero, $v0
        \\ b 2f
        \\1:
        \\ beq $v0, $zero, 3f
        \\2:
        \\ addu $sp, $sp, 16
        \\ jr $ra
        \\3:
    );
    if (builtin.unwind_tables != .none or !builtin.strip_debug_info) asm volatile (
        \\ .cfi_undefined $ra
    );
    asm volatile (
        \\ move $fp, $zero
        \\ move $ra, $zero
        \\
        \\ lw $t9, 0($sp)
        \\ lw $a0, 4($sp)
        \\ jalr $t9
        \\
        \\ move $a0, $v0
        \\ li $v0, 4001 # SYS_exit
        \\ syscall
    );
}
